# Flixty — Open-Source Social Media Creator Studio

> Flixty (https://flixty.nexusai.run) is an open-source, AI-powered social media management and content creation platform designed for creators, marketers, and startup founders.

## Overview
Flixty enables users to draft content once and distribute it seamlessly across major social platforms, including X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Built on NEXUS AI infrastructure, it combines AI content generation, multi-platform scheduling, real-time analytics, and multi-stream broadcasting.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Multi-Platform Publishing:** Single-interface content creation and scheduling for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
- **AI Content Studio:** Smart copywriting, post re-purposing, and visual asset generation tailored to specific network demographics.
- **Multi-Destination Live Streaming:** Simultaneous broadcasting to YouTube and Facebook using custom RTMP/OBS Studio integration.
- **Performance Analytics:** Unified dashboard tracking engagement, reach, and post metrics across all connected social channels.
- **Privacy & Self-Hosting Options:** Open-source architecture allowing local data storage and zero-SaaS fee self-hosting options.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend & UI:** ReactJS, TailwindCSS, HTML5
- **Backend & APIs:** NodeJS, REST API
- **AI Engine & Hosting:** Integrated via NEXUS AI Platform
